newsitem.title: USA: Colony Capital joins Santa Anita bid - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Colony Capital joins Santa Anita bid - WSJ.

text.p: Colony Capital Inc has teamed up with Koll Co and New York-based Apollo Real Estate Advisors in a bid to gain a controlling stake in Santa Anita Realty Enterprises, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition on Monday.
Koll and Apollo have already made an offer which would give Santa Anita shareholders $27 per share and provide the racetrack and real-estate firm about $91.5 million in equity, the paper said.
But the Wall Street Journal, citing sources familiar with the deal, said Colony has agreed to join with Koll and Apollo by making the same tender offer to Santa shareholders.
The new package would add another $25 million in equity to the package, the paper said.
